name: Being Sober
overview: Scripture calls believers to a life of sober-mindedness, recognizing the grace and measure of faith God has given each person (Romans 12:3). This sobriety involves self-control and vigilance, especially as seen in the instruction for older men to be temperate and sound in faith (Titus 2:2). Additionally, believers are urged to avoid drunkenness, which leads to excess, and instead be filled with the Spirit, highlighting the contrast between worldly indulgence and spiritual sobriety (Ephesians 5:18).
